title: Raging Vortex
html:
Raging Vortex is an Air Myrmidon action that creates a swirling vortex that deals damage and silences any creature inside.

Description

Spiral the wind into a choking maelstrom that inflicts 2d8⁠⁠Bludgeoning damage per turn and  Silences creatures.

Properties

Cost
 Action
Damage: 2~16
2d8⁠Bludgeoning

Creatures that remain in the aura are  Silenced and take 2d8⁠⁠Bludgeoning damage per turn.

Type: Summoned

Condition: Raging Vortex

 Raging Vortex
  • Affected entity is  Silenced and is being dealt 2d8⁠⁠Bludgeoning damage per turn while remaining in the vortex.

Condition: Silenced

 Silenced
  • Creature can't speak or cast spells with a verbal component, and is immune to ⁠Thunder damage.

How to learn

Used by creatures: Air Myrmidon and Wild Shape: Air Myrmidon

Notes

  • Each Air myrmidon can only have one Raging Vortex active at a time.
  • This ability does not require concentration. As a side effect, this means the only way to cancel the effect early is to create a new Raging Vortex.
